changelog:
Initial release of muxray.

- Inspect tmux panes and report their program and state as structured JSON.
- Core commands: list, status, scan, watch, snapshot, diff, inspect, doctor.
- Read-only tool: does not send keystrokes or modify sessions.
- Focused on supervising and classifying coding agents (Claude, Codex, Copilot) inside tmux.
- Provides fleet-level view, reliable snapshot/diff, and safe command invocation.
summary: Inspect tmux panes as JSON: snapshot, diff, and classify Claude/Codex/Copilot agent state across the whole fleet.
